projects.title: Aarusha Portal
projects.description: The Aarusha Portal is a web-based guest-portal for Aarusha Homes, an all-inclusive hostel for low-income workers in India. With the Aarusha Portal, guests are connected to the hostel management and can receive information, send feedback, and manage their stay. For the management, the data from guests are compiled and displayed in one place in order to facilitate smooth and efficient workings within the hostel.
